newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firmer, US arb open.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firmer, US arb open.

text.p: NWE gasoline was firmer on Wednesday as U.S. demand, boosted by bullish industry stock data, buoyed prices , traders said.
Eurograde barges traded in the morning at $185.50 a tonne fob ARA in what dealers said was a "dummy trade."
Regular barrels changed hands at $177 and $172.50. The
latter trade was seen some $3 below market, while the former was seen to be around a dollar above it.
Eurograde cargoes were only notionally talked amid a scarcity of offers. One dealer notionally pegged cargo offers in to Hamburg at around $194 a tonne.
Dealers expected material to move across the Atlantic from Europe, considering that the arbitrage window is now open. But details of specific deals were not known.
